Depuis son lancement en 2018, Swile a révolutionné le marché des avantages salariés.
En digitalisant la gestion et l’utilisation des avantages, grâce à notre super app, nous avons amélioré l’expérience, afin de la rendre plus simple, plus moderne et plus intuitive.

En tant que  AML Compliance Officer Senior, tu intégreras l'équipe Compliance de Swile Payment pour devenir un des référents opérationnels sur la prévention du blanchiment de capitaux et du financement du terrorisme (LCB-FT).

Ton rôle consistera à plonger au cœur des opérations pour sécuriser la croissance de Swile, piloter le traitement des alertes LCB-FT et optimiser/automatiser nos processus de conformité dans un environnement multi-produits (régulés la Mobilité, le Wallet, et prochainement l'Expense et également non régulé comme le Titre-Restaurant).

À ce titre, tu seras notamment en charge de :

  • Traiter et analyser le flux d'alertes LCB-FT : Assurer la surveillance continue des opérations (Transaction Monitoring, screening, scoring clients personnes physiques et morales) et instruire les alertes complexes au quotidien. 

  • Piloter les investigations et les déclarations TRACFIN : Analyser les comportements atypiques ou suspects, procéder à la collecte de données approfondie et rédiger les déclarations de soupçon auprès de TRACFIN. 

  • Scale et automatisation des processus LCB-FT : Participer activement à la construction, l'affinage et l'optimisation des scénarios de surveillance et des outils (notamment l'usage d'outils comme SALV et la mise en place de briques d'IA) pour fluidifier le traitement du volume et préparer les échéances réglementaires de 2027. 

  • Participer aux reportings et exigences réglementaires : Contribuer à la rédaction et à l'envoi des reportings réglementaires (QLB, Observatoire de l'inclusion bancaire, etc.) en lien avec l'ACPR et la vision globale du risque. 

  • Collaborer à l'international et en interne : Être un point de contact clé pour les équipes Risk & Control, Produit et Tech, et échanger régulièrement avec nos équipes compliance basées au Brésil pour harmoniser nos standards. 

  • Participer à l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires/outils : Suivre le déploiement opérationnel des nouveaux prestataires (KYB, screening) pour soutenir le lancement des nouvelles offres (Expense, cartes à offrir, etc.).

  • Former et embarquer les équipes, en France et au Brésil : sensibilisation LCB-FT des équipes exposées et diffusion des bons réflexes IA.

    • Ton futur impact chez Swile :

    Chez Swile, la conformité n'est pas un frein mais un moteur pour scale de manière saine et durable.

    En rejoignant l'équipe Legal & Compliance à Paris, tu auras un impact direct et immédiat :

  • Un pilier opérationnel LCB-FT : Tu deviens le garant d'une analyse fine des risques sur nos flux d'argent, en apportant des réponses claires sur les dossiers sensibles et à risque.

  • Un accélérateur d'automatisation : En tirant parti de l'IA et de nos outils RegTech, tu contribues à transformer des tâches manuelles de volumétrie en processus intelligents et automatisés et auditable.

  • Un facilitateur de croissance internationale : Tu accompagnes le déploiement de produits complexes comme l'Expense sur le marché français et international (notamment en lien avec notre filiale au Brésil).

Au quotidien, tu évolueras sur des situations parfois urgentes, sensibles ou complexes, avec un haut niveau d’exigence en matière de fiabilité, de personnalisation et de sens du service. Ton rôle sera clé pour garantir une expérience client premium, sécuriser chaque prise en charge et contribuer à faire progresser durablement nos standards.

  • Garantir une prise en charge premium au quotidien, en assurant réactivité, fiabilité, précision et qualité de service

  • Documenter chaque situation avec rigueur : assurer une bonne traçabilité et utiliser les outils avec sérieux pour garantir une exécution fiable

jobs.description:
Sobre nós ✨
 
A Swile é a scaleup pioneira de benefícios flexíveis no Brasil e na França. A nossa missão é ajudar a oferecer um melhor ambiente de trabalho para os seus colaboradores através dos benefícios flexíveis que entregamos por meio de uma tecnologia de ponta.
 
Fundada em 2016 e reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar pelo GPTW (Great Place to Work 2023), a Vee se uniu à Swile, a mais inovadora ScaleUp europeia e que revolucionou o mercado de benefícios na França em 2021, se tornando um unicórnio global 🚀
 
Sobre a posição 🔥
 
A posição de Sales Executive tem papel estratégico dentro da equipe de Mid Market. Será responsável por contribuir diretamente com o crescimento da Swile.
 
  • Reportar os status dos fechamentos de vendas junto à liderança comercial;
  • Gestão do funil de vendas e carteira de clientes através do Salesforce (ou CRM correlato) e ferramentas fornecidas pela empresa;
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais (eventos e viagens);
  • Prospectar novos clientes: Identificar oportunidades de vendas e estabelecer contato com potenciais clientes.
  • Apresentar produtos ou serviços: Explicar detalhadamente as características e benefícios do serviços oferecido;
  • Negociar contratos: Discutir termos de vendas, preços, condições de pagamento e outros detalhes do contrato;
  • Fechamento de vendas: Concluir a venda garantindo a satisfação do cliente e o cumprimento dos termos acordados;
  • Pós-venda: Manter contato com os clientes para garantir sua satisfação e identificar oportunidades de vendas adicionais;
  • Relatórios de vendas: Monitorar e relatar regularmente o progresso das vendas para a gerência.
  • Conhecimento do produto: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos ou serviços oferecidos, bem como sobre as tendências e condições do mercado;
  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar com a equipe de vendas interna e outras áreas para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Governança de processos: Garantir a gestão do funil de vendas dentro do CRM, atualizado e com todo o acompanhamento até o processo final de fechamento da venda.
 
Em conjunto com o time, você irá ajudar a alavancar resultados e crescimento da Swile Brasil para o nível máximo.
Aqui, você terá autonomia para identificar oportunidades e executar as estratégias adequadas ao momento e aos desafios!

lists.content:
Swile évolue dans un environnement réglementaire exigeant, avec de nombreux produits, tous soumis à des spécificités juridiques particulières (droit bancaire, droit social, droit de la consommation, droit du tourisme…). Nous avons également l’ambition de conquérir l’Europe, et déployer nos produits dans des pays soumis à d’autres réglementations locales.

Afin de nous accompagner dans le développement de nos produits et notre développement international, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Senior Legal Counsel - Product, Innovation & Regulatory Affairs, qui aura pour mission de :

  • Accompagner les équipes Produit, et ce dès la phase de conception, dans le cadre du lancement d’un nouveau produit ou d’une fonctionnalité, afin que ceux-ci soient développés dans un cadre conforme à la réglementation (droit bancaire/des paiements, droit social, droit de la consommation, etc.), et en adéquation avec les enjeux business de Swile ;
  • Apporter des réponses aux différentes équipes sur les questions relatives à la réglementation afférente à nos produits (marketing, sales, service client, produit, etc.) ;
  • Travailler étroitement avec les autres membres de l’équipe juridique, que ce soit sur des points précis ou des projets transverses communs ;
  • Rédiger et/ou revoir en binôme avec l'équipe Legal Business les contrats propres aux activités réglementées de Swile (clauses dans les CGV, contrats-cadre de paiement, etc. ;
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe conformité lorsqu’une analyse juridique est nécessaire sur nos produits réglementés par le droit bancaire, y compris dans le cadre de ses diligences auprès du régulateur, l’ACPR ;
  • Travailler main dans la main avec les différentes parties prenantes sur le déploiement de produits conformes à l’international ;
  • Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle sur la réglementation afférente aux produits Swile, notamment afin d’anticiper les différentes réglementations susceptibles de s’appliquer à Swile et de les diffuser au sein des équipes (DSP3, PSR, ECGT, etc.) d’une part, et afin d’alimenter l’équipe interne Affaires Publiques sur le droit prospectif et les enjeux juridiques du moment pour Swile ; et
  • Accompagner l’équipe Affaires Publiques lorsque cela est nécessaire, sur les points juridiques.

jobs.description:
Swile is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the post-booking experience for business travelers. The role covers the full Customer Care journey, from self-service in the app to the tools used by support agents and the integrations with airlines, rail operators, hotels and car rental companies.

You will lead product for a cross-functional team of engineers and a designer, while working closely with Customer Care leadership, engineering teams and colleagues across France and Brazil. The position offers the opportunity to shape a scalable travel operations product and contribute to Swile’s European expansion within a culture of autonomy, ownership and high product standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the Travel Operations roadmap and help Swile scale travel volumes without a proportional increase in operational headcount.
  • Improve the entire post-booking journey, including changes, cancellations, disruptions, refunds and supplier confirmations.
  • Use contact data, conversation transcripts and time spent with agents to identify root causes and solve recurring issues in the product.
  • Lead the adoption of AI agents across chat, phone and email, defining which cases can be automated, when humans should take over and how the agent role should evolve.
  • Build and improve the back-office and other tools used by Customer Care teams.
  • Drive automation and operational excellence in partnership with Customer Care leadership, covering processes, routing, SLAs and launch readiness.
  • Track success through metrics such as contact rate, self-service resolution, time to resolution, cost per contact and traveler satisfaction.

Profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of an operations-heavy product such as customer care, servicing, marketplace operations or logistics.
  • Experience building internal tools and back-office products with a strong focus on operational users.
  • Comfortable working with complex integrations, APIs, event flows, data consistency and edge cases.
  • Data-driven, with the ability to combine dashboards, operational data and customer verbatims.
  • Practical understanding of how AI can improve support, how to assess its reliability and how it impacts agents’ work.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to influence stakeholders from frontline teams to senior leadership.
  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Previous experience in travel is not required. Candidates from both entrepreneurial and established-company environments are welcome, with a focus on product depth, operational impact and demonstrated results.

Our recruitment process : 

  • Alizée (Recruitment Team) : an initial conversation to assess the fit between your profile and our expectations.
  • Timothy (future manager) : a discussion about our short- and long-term plans, our roadmap and the milestones ahead.
  • Conversation with peers
  • Eric (CTPO) : the final step to wrap up the interview process.

About us ✨
 
At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.
 
About the role 🔥
 
For those who are passionate about continuous improvement, this position is for you.
This software engineer will help our developers optimize our current app integrating best practices—whether in a single line of code or the entire architecture. Autonomy goes hand in hand with communication.
Being a Senior Software Engineer at Swile means positively impacting the lives of our clients and users by making data-driven decisions and ensuring efficiency, stability, and performance in our applications. By translating product visions into software, we solve complex problems that enable a unique, stable, and functional experience for everyone.
As backend engineers, we work on applications such as REST APIs, dashboards, tools, and internal services that allow our clients and users to access their benefits flexibly, easily, and reliably whenever needed.
 
Main responsibilities 🧩
 
Software Engineering
Write high-quality, well-documented, efficient, tested, and maintainable code
Ensure and improve observability and monitoring of our applications
Proactively focus on enhancing other team members’ technical skills, coding standards, and overall code quality
Learn new programming languages when needed
Actively work on improving the security, performance, and stability of applications
Conduct and receive high-quality code reviews
Design and Architecture
Provide technical guidance by contributing to informed, objective, and simple solution discussions
Propose architectural solutions, collaborating and mentoring other team members to meet both functional and non-functional requirements
Execution and Delivery
Estimate and plan timelines for deliverables with stakeholders and the product team
Leverage existing Swile solutions to align with global platforms
Work with loosely defined or ambiguous requirements to help shape better solutions alongside product and team members
Build incremental solutions with the product team to promote continuous improvement and delivery
Focus on delivering well-tested and automated features, including E2E tests, to ensure application stability
Monitor and respond to incidents in production
Leadership
Lead projects, ensuring delivery within estimated timelines
Help technically grow team members by being a role model
Participate in hiring processes for engineers at the same or lower levels
 
Minimum Requirements ✅
 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields—or equivalent practical experience
Professional experience in software engineering using Java or Kotlin
Experience in designing and developing distributed systems
Experience with technologies such as Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar
Experience with relational and non-relational databases
Clear and effective communication skills
Advanced English C1 level

jobs.description:
About us 

At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.

About the role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Platform team, responsible for building and evolving a large-scale financial infrastructure serving millions of users.

You will work on core payment and banking capabilities, including accounts, wallets, balances, payment authorization, card lifecycle management, compliance integrations, and reporting services. The platform is primarily built in Ruby, and you will contribute to its evolution in a highly autonomous and product-driven environment.

As part of a global engineering organization, you will collaborate closely with teammates across Brazil and France, partnering with Product and Engineering leaders to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.

We are looking for engineers who combine strong technical fundamentals with product thinking, business awareness, and a high level of ownership.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your mission will be to:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and monitor backend services in production environments.

  • Contribute to the evolution of a large-scale payments platform supporting millions of users.

  • Work primarily with Ruby-based backend systems, evolving and maintaining core services.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve real business problems.

  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic and scalable technical solutions.

  • Drive architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and security.

  • Lead projects end-to-end, ensuring high-quality execution and delivery.

  • Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices.

  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team.

  • Facilitate communication and alignment across distributed teams.

What We're Looking For:

  • Significant experience building and operating backend systems in production.

  • Strong understanding of software design, distributed systems, and scalable architectures.

  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

  • Experience with messaging and event-driven systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.

  • Ability to work autonomously and take ownership of complex problems from discovery to delivery.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Product mindset and ability to understand business context when making technical decisions.

  • Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate in a global environment.

  • Fluent/Advanced English proficiency (C1-C2 Level).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience with compliance, KYC, or financial reporting systems.

  • Previous experience working in international and distributed teams.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to shape critical payment infrastructure, solve complex engineering challenges at scale, and work alongside a highly autonomous team that values ownership, collaboration, simplicity, and continuous improvement.
